title: How Showing Up Ten Minutes Early Trains a Godly Man to Be Trusted
caption:
Ten minutes early is how a godly man gets trusted.

It's not about the clock. It's about whether your word holds on the small stuff, because Scripture says the man faithful with little is faithful with much.

Who is waiting on you to show up early this week?
